description: Cloud Run platform request-log HTTP504 with latency>=290s. Bounded Gemini route/action classification; other routes remain unclassified. Long-duration response signal, not proof of timeout cause.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.project_id="based-hardware" AND logName="projects/based-hardware/logs/run.googleapis.com%2Frequests" AND httpRequest.status = 504 AND httpRequest.latency >= "290s"

labels.description: Only fixed Gemini route family; empty means unclassified, not a template for other paths.
Four fixed Gemini actions or empty; never model, URL, ID or arbitrary action.
